direct_reply_pairs.response_scope: P3 from Your two heart-moving notes have come to paragraph end. Exclude P1–2 and the earlier doctor update within P3. Later medical updates remain separately dated material.

response_sections.quote: Your two heart-moving notes have come. My dear dear wife.— I do not sit all the while, with her, but am constantly up & down: I cannot sit still.—

direct_reply_pairs.response_date_policy: April 20, during the eight AM section after the doctor update. Incoming notes cannot condition earlier prose.
direct_reply_pairs.rationale: Emma asks him to let Fanny watch rather than exhaust himself. After acknowledging two notes, Darwin immediately answers that he does not sit constantly. Only 1404 is identified by this distinctive concern.

evidence.quote: you must let her experienced eye do some of the watching
you will be quite exhausted
Your two heart-moving notes have come.
I do not sit all the while, with her, but am constantly up & down

direct_reply_pairs.response_scope: 1408 P3 only: the garden/flower acknowledgement and Annie gratitude. Do not duplicate unrelated daily medical updates as part of this answer.

response_sections.quote: My own dear how it did make me cry to read of your going to Annie’s garden for a flower. I wish you could see her now the perfection of gentleness, patience & gratitude,—thankful till it is truly painful to hear her.— poor dear little soul.—

direct_reply_pairs.response_date_policy: April 21, before the noon update. Exact receipt day is not established by the earlier generic acknowledgement of two notes.
direct_reply_pairs.rationale: The specific garden and flower wording identifies 1405 independently of catalogue adjacency.

evidence.quote: I was in the garden looking at my poor darling’s little garden to find a flower of hers
how it did make me cry to read of your going to Annie’s garden for a flower

correspondent_replies.response_scope: 1404 P1 doctor-watch and hope response; P2–3 add plans.
correspondent_replies.rationale: The explicit overnight stay of Gully uniquely matches 1400 P2.

evidence.quote: Dr. Gully slept here last night & is most kind
How kind of Dr Gully to sleep in the house

correspondent_replies.response_scope: 1405 reaction to the forwarded telegram, especially P1 and P3–4; P2 adds messenger arrangements.
correspondent_replies.rationale: 1403 directs the nine AM message through Erasmus to Down. 1402 corroborates dispatch and 1405 records delivery at 4:15 PM. Preserve the intermediary route and distinguish the message from the postal letter.

evidence.quote: Please send man to sydenham station thence in fly to down
Saturday morning nine o clock
the Electric telegraph message, which I despatched at 9 this morning
The message is just arrived
John Griffith’s drove up

correspondent_replies.routing: Charles Darwin to Erasmus Alvey Darwin, then a messenger to Emma. Identities remain distinct; relay text is not invented.

correspondent_replies.response_scope: 1409 P1 joint answer to Saturday/Sunday reports, including Etty travel; one Emma letter.
correspondent_replies.rationale: Monday noon chronology, two letters, and Etty London/Leith Hill details match 1402 with 1406. Later Monday reports are excluded.

evidence.quote: Etty is gone with Hannah to London by Cheltenham Coach
on Monday she goes with the others to Leith Hill
Your 2 letters are come & dear Fanny’s
I have sent Bessy up to fetch Etty & she probably will find her gone to Leith Hill

correspondent_replies.response_scope: 1409 P1 hourly report and child responsiveness acknowledgement within the joint Saturday/Sunday reply.
correspondent_replies.rationale: Darwin offers an account of every hour and Emma calls those accounts precious. The absence of a second Saturday late letter and Monday noon timing distinguish this pair from future Monday reports.

evidence.quote: I had not time to send a second later letter yesterday
it is best for you to know how every hour passes
Your account of every hour is most precious

correspondent_replies.response_scope: Tuesday April 22 P1–3 joint response; Wednesday P4–5 are the returned-address postscript.
correspondent_replies.rationale: Explicit two Monday letters, bowel action and Catherine visit identify 1408 alongside 1408A.

evidence.quote: Your 2 letters of Monday are certainly better
so have her bowels, after above a week
I feel greatly relieved at the bowels acting

correspondent_replies.response_scope: Tuesday April 22 P1–3 joint response; exclude Wednesday resend section.
correspondent_replies.rationale: The explicit pair of improved Monday reports identifies the separate 7:30 PM follow-up alongside 1408. This establishes Emma reading, not Darwin receipt of her answer.

evidence.quote: Your 2 letters of Monday are certainly better
everything going on as favourably as possible

correspondent_replies.response_scope: April 23 before-post P1–3 only; exclude after-post P4.
correspondent_replies.rationale: Monday letter, vinegar sponging and Catherine caregiving discussion identify 1408. Later rereading does not imply new receipt.

evidence.quote: your letter of Monday
I enjoyed the spunging our dear one with vinegar as much as you did
we bathed her with vinegar & water, & it was delicious to see how it soothed her

correspondent_replies.response_scope: P1 from Your letter is just come to paragraph end; P2 valediction and P3 Willy news follow. Earlier mourning precedes receipt.
correspondent_replies.rationale: Explicit arrival followed by comfort from Annie happy innocent life identifies 1412. Earlier grief follows silence and Fanny report.

evidence.quote: Your letter is just come
a very short life but I trust happy
the only comfort I can take in thinking of her happy innocent life

response_sections.quote: Your letter is just come & I feel less miserable a good deal in the hopes of seeing you sooner than I expected, but do not be in a hurry to set off. I am perfectly well. You do give me the only comfort I can take in thinking of her happy innocent life. She never concealed a thought, & so affectionate so forgiving. What a blank it is. Don’t think of coming in one day. We shall be much less miserable together.

reference_observations.description: Excluded authorial text proposes two letters for safety, but 1406 says no second later letter was sent Saturday. Do not invent another dispatched original.
Footnote 7 quotes Fanny Mackintosh Wedgwood with an original Tuesday 21st dateline corrected to April 22. Keep this letter separate from Fanny Allen and from Emma authorial prose.

rejected_or_candidate_links.rationale: A Monday noon response cannot answer the reports completed at three PM and 7:30 PM that day. The earlier 1402 and 1406 are accepted instead.
1405 may be the other incoming note, but a count of two is not unique evidence. Its garden passage is explicitly answered in 1408 next day; do not force the earlier receipt date.
The precious look may echo 1399, but the overnight doctor stay uniquely identifies 1400. No additional edge is asserted from general sympathy.
